skill.name: email-systems
skill.description: Guides planning and review of transactional email, marketing automation, deliverability, and email infrastructure. Covers queues, event tracking, template versioning, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, bounce handling, unsubscribe requirements, and volume warm-up.
skill.summary: Plan reliable email systems with deliverability, compliance, tracking, and infrastructure guidance.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Email systems often fail through poor deliverability, weak tracking, and missing compliance controls. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code plan safer transactional and marketing email workflows.
actual_capabilities: Plan transactional email queues with retry logic and monitoring.
Review event tracking for deliveries, opens, clicks, bounces, and complaints.
Guide template versioning for rollback and A/B testing.
Identify deliverability gaps around SPF, DKIM, DMARC, and IP warm-up.
Highlight compliance issues such as unsubscribe links and opt-in requirements.
limitations: Does not verify live DNS records or sender reputation.
Does not provide provider-specific API implementation details.
Does not replace legal review for consent, privacy, or marketing rules.
Does not monitor production email performance after deployment.

use_cases.title: Launch Transactional Email
use_cases.description: Design reliable password reset, welcome, receipt, and notification emails with retries and monitoring.

use_cases.title: Improve Deliverability
use_cases.description: Review sender authentication, bounce handling, unsubscribe visibility, and warm-up plans before scaling volume.

use_cases.title: Standardize Email Operations
use_cases.description: Create reusable practices for tracking events, versioning templates, and managing complaints across teams.

prompt_templates.title: Review Deliverability Basics
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my planned transactional email setup. Check SPF, DKIM, DMARC, plain text fallback, unsubscribe handling, and bounce processing.

prompt_templates.title: Design Transactional Queue
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a transactional email queue for my product. Include retry rules, monitoring signals, bounce handling, and template versioning.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Marketing Automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this lifecycle email plan. Identify segmentation, personalization, opt-in, complaint handling, and deliverability risks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan High Volume Migration
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an IP warm-up and sender reputation plan for moving from shared sending to dedicated email infrastructure.

output_examples.input: A startup asks how to send welcome and password reset emails reliably.
output_examples.output: A queue-based transactional design with retries, delivery tracking, bounce processing, and template rollback guidance.

output_examples.input: A growth team wants to increase newsletter volume from a new sender domain.
output_examples.output: A deliverability checklist covering authentication, opt-in quality, complaint monitoring, unsubscribe links, and gradual volume warm-up.

output_examples.input: An engineering manager needs standards for email templates.
output_examples.output: A template versioning approach with rollback rules, A/B test support, text fallbacks, and event tracking requirements.

best_practices: Start with verified opt-in lists and clear unsubscribe handling.
Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC before increasing volume.
Send multipart emails with useful text and HTML versions.
anti_patterns: Sending to contacts who did not give clear permission.
Using image-only designs that block accessibility and deliverability.
Raising volume from a new IP without a warm-up plan.

faq.question: Does this skill write email sending code?
faq.answer: It focuses on architecture, review, and operational guidance. Provider-specific implementation still needs normal engineering work.

faq.question: Can it check my DNS records directly?
faq.answer: No. It can explain which SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records to verify, but it does not query live DNS.

faq.question: Does it cover both transactional and marketing email?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers queues, tracking, deliverability, automation, unsubscribe handling, and sender reputation planning.

faq.question: Is this a compliance tool?
faq.answer: No. It highlights consent and unsubscribe risks, but legal requirements should be reviewed by qualified counsel.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it during product planning?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill can guide requirements, architecture reviews, and operational checklists for email features.

faq.question: What problems does it help prevent?
faq.answer: It helps prevent spam-folder placement, missing bounce handling, weak tracking, broken templates, and unsafe volume increases.
